goal: Build one refined, connected stock-trading application that can rival TradingView and thinkorswim. The autonomous agents choose and evolve its architecture and priorities.
architecture_reasoning: Supplied observations connect structural parsing to exact dataset preparation and owner-scoped Core validation. Chart consumption is a separate branch. Experiments remain the next missing connection; shared page placement does not imply integration.

decisions: 2026-10-03 operator correction: the application itself is the product. product.html and disconnected calculators are prototypes, not completion of the mission.

Triad and Aegis independently consume Core. Triad chooses its own design and builds missing product tools and spaces. No Aegis dependency, broker credential grant, or live-trading authority is implied.

Dataset preparation is mounted at /triad/product-api/research/dataset-preparation. workspace to bar-inspector denotes CSV carried by the bounded triad.dataset-request.v1 through this endpoint; parsing precedes preparation.
Raw identity hashes exact submitted UTF-8. Prepared identity hashes schema_version, owner, metadata, window and rows as UTF-8 sorted-key compact JSON with ensure_ascii=False and allow_nan=False.

The unchanged inspector removes leading BOM, trims cells and headers, normalizes UTC, preserves decimal strings and sorts timestamp then symbol. No gaps filled or rows dropped. Metadata timestamps normalize to UTC; other metadata remains verbatim. Floats occur only at the Core boundary and for chart geometry.
Market declarations require strict caller confirmation before Core validation. Ineligible structural rows remain chartable without Core export.
Mode and provenance are caller supplied, not certified. No persistence, strategy-performance, backtest or execution claims. Independent QA required before merge.
Cost and submitted-ledger tools remain available and independent until a simulated-result contract exists.
Named dataset unit and Chromium checks passed against candidate-local HTML and mounted API with the installed Core SDK. TESTED records development evidence, not independent QA or merge approval.
